claims.claim: Dubai luxury home sales fell about 17 percent in the third quarter compared with the previous year.
claims.episode_span: Sales of luxury homes in Dubai fell approximately 17 percent in the third quarter compared with the previous year, according to researcher Knight Frank.
claims.source_title: Dubai Luxury Home Sales Fall From Record Levels as War Drags On
claims.supporting_quote: Wealthy buyers from around the world continued to snap up Dubai luxury homes during the third quarter, according to researcher Knight Frank, although sales volumes declined about 17% from last year as the Iran war dragged on.

claims.claim: US investors completed 76 acquisitions and investments in German industrial and manufacturing companies last year, valued at about $29.5 billion.
claims.episode_span: US investors completed 76 acquisitions and investments in German industrial and manufacturing companies last year, valued at about $29.5 billion, nearly double the 2022 total.
claims.source_title: Why US investors are snapping up Germany's famed Mittelstand
claims.supporting_quote: Last year, US investors were involved in 76 acquisitions and investments in German industrial and manufacturing companies, according to an analysis by financial data provider PitchBook. The transactions were valued at about $29.5 billion (€26.3 billion) in 2025, nearly double the 2022 total.
